SELECT p.id,p.name,p.description,p.category_id,p.main_image,p.sales,p.status,p.spec_mode,p.spec_definition, p.create_time,p.update_time,s.min_price AS price,s.max_price,s.total_stock, LEAST(COALESCE(s.total_stock,0),2147483647) AS stock, CASE WHEN p.spec_mode='SINGLE' THEN s.default_sku_id ELSE NULL END AS default_sku_id FROM product p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT product_id,MIN(price) min_price,MAX(price) max_price,SUM(stock) total_stock, MAX(CASE WHEN spec_key='DEFAULT' THEN id ELSE NULL END) default_sku_id FROM product_sku WHERE status='ENABLED' GROUP BY product_id ) s ON s.product_id=p.id
AND p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND p.category_id IN (SELECT id FROM product_category WHERE id = #{categoryId} OR parent_id = #{categoryId})
AND p.status = #{status} AND s.product_id IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.min_price ASC, p.id ASC ORDER BY s.min_price DESC, p.id DESC ORDER BY p.sales DESC, p.id DESC ORDER BY p.create_time DESC, p.id DESC
